# `company.customer_credit_transfers`

Customer credit moved between jobs of one customer: the charge on the source and the credit memo on the target.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this credit transfer. |
| `operation_key` | VARCHAR(128) | no | — | unique | — | — | Caller-chosen key; asking again with it returns this transfer instead of moving the credit twice. |
| `from_party_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_credit_transfers_from | customers.id | Customer or job the credit was moved from. |
| `to_party_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_credit_transfers_to | customers.id | Customer or job the credit was moved to. |
| `transfer_date` | VARCHAR(10) | no | — | — | ix_credit_transfers_from, ix_credit_transfers_to | — | Date of the transfer, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `amount_minor_units` | BIGINT | no | — | — | — | — | Credit moved, in home-currency minor units. |
| `currency` | VARCHAR(3) | no | — | — | — | — | Home currency of the amount. |
| `charge_invoice_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique | — | transactions.id | Invoice that charged the source job, paid by the credit it had. |
| `credit_memo_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique | — | transactions.id | Credit memo that gave the credit to the target job. |
| `reason` | VARCHAR(500) | no | — | — | — | — | Why the credit was moved, as the writer gave it. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC timestamp the transfer was recorded. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Principal that recorded the transfer. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface the transfer came through. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that committed the transfer record. |
